# P2a final scoped UI review — PASS

Reviewed frozen Source `7e3f72ebfaef39d6e6630dd11fa7dc91c8985d4a`, with all 4,743
Source hashes and digest `d64467aee29afb00a1a009cf94cdcdad10600160fc529dfcf3c91e9648e064f1`
verified. This is a final owner UI review of the additive raw identity transport,
using actual current test and SDK evidence. Root retains full-app/native visual,
full CI and canonical parity/merge gates. No visual or native UI pass is claimed.

No blocking findings remain in this scope. The current normal `android_ui` run
passed 125 tests with zero failures, zero filtered tests and one unchanged,
pre-existing native-capture ignore. I verified its raw-log SHA256
`2488cdaa0fff210d42064ca571adcfdd236fa9afce17ee7a69edb831591491c5`
and fresh compiler binding to this worktree. The same frozen Source also has
291 passing all-feature tooling tests, a fresh normal library build, strict
repository Clippy and workspace formatting passes. I inspected their receipts
and byte-exact logs without rerunning runtime commands.

The actual official Gradle runs cover baseline, custom nested Java projects,
duplicate raw project/Idea names and names finalized by late project-evaluation
callbacks. I independently compared all three complete old/current model pairs:
removing only `importFacts` leaves the complete Basic and V2 envelope equal,
including all field values and vector order, with no path/value normalization.
The current Rust probe decodes all three models and verifies their freshness
binding. The late sidecar name exactly equals the separate official getter
oracle. Root holders and null Idea names remain distinct from compiled modules
and invented display names. The existing included-build guard rejects both old
and current attempts, yielding eight actual captures and no new compatibility
claim. Probe source/binary and current bridge hashes are bound to frozen Source.

These are supplementary private captures with JDK 21, Gradle 9.6.1, AGP 9.4 and
SDK/build-tools 37. They add zero original reference-test credit. The private
build-tools pin changes no repository fixtures, source, SDK installations or
licenses. The earlier build-tools 36 probe failure, three semantic fix rounds,
strict-quality failure, separate clone cleanup and ENOSPC interruption remain
retained; successful retry evidence does not erase them.

The static boundary remains intact: raw getter decoding has no shipping UI
consumer, cannot clear the Basic model and supplies no guessed imported name,
Kotlin facet or logical tree display. UI/editor/theme and Basic/V2 consumer
sources remain unchanged. The tree is still physical, raw JSON is still shown
in the existing Sync console, and original generated-tree methods remain
applicable and unported. This review claims no overall Android Studio visual
match, importer/facet/tree completion, large-project or native performance.

Root still owns current full-app build and screenshots, loading/empty/error
states, resizing/focus and cleanup, full CI, exact reference captures and
protected-branch merge. Prior reports and failure logs are preserved. This
review executed no Cargo, rustc, JVM, Gradle, SDK or native command and changed
no Source, Git/index or cache file. The read hold is released after these
external report files are written and their hashes are reported.
